parts:

res2 = plot_BioGeoBEARS_results(results_object, analysis_titletxt, addl_params=list("j"), plotwhat="text", label.offset=NULL, tipcex=0.9, statecex=0.7, splitcex=0.7, titlecex=0.9, plotsplits=TRUE, cornercoords_loc=scriptdir, include_null_range=TRUE, tr=tr, tipranges=tipranges)

here is the error message: 

Error in marprobs[leftright_nodes_matrix[, 1], ] : índice fora de limites

In matrix(data = unlist(daughter_nds), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE) :

Can anyone give a light in this problem, please?
